claims.object_text: repressor of the mTORC1 signaling pathway
claims.quote: DEP-domain containing 5 (DEPDC5), encoding a repressor of the mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) signaling pathway,

claims.object_text: mutated in familial focal epilepsies and focal cortical dysplasia
claims.quote: has recently emerged as a major gene mutated in familial focal epilepsies and focal cortical dysplasia.
Here we established a global knockout rat using TALEN technology to investigate in vivo the impact of Depdc5-deficiency.

claims.object_text: homozygous Depdc5(-/-) embryos die at embryonic day 14.5 with global growth delay
claims.quote: Homozygous Depdc5(-/-) embryos died from embryonic day 14.5 due to a global growth delay.

claims.object_text: Constitutive mTORC1 hyperactivation with enhanced phosphorylation of S6K1 and rpS6
claims.quote: Constitutive mTORC1 hyperactivation was evidenced in the brains and in cultured fibroblasts of Depdc5(-/-) embryos, as reflected by enhanced phosphorylation of its downstream effectors S6K1 and rpS6.

claims.object_text: prenatal mTORC1 inhibitor rapamycin rescues Depdc5(-/-) embryo phenotype
claims.quote: Consistently, prenatal treatment with mTORC1 inhibitor rapamycin rescued the phenotype of Depdc5(-/-) embryos.

claims.object_text: heterozygous Depdc5(+/-) rats develop normally and exhibit no spontaneous electroclinical seizures
claims.quote: Heterozygous Depdc5(+/-) rats developed normally and exhibited no spontaneous electroclinical seizures,

claims.object_text: altered cortical neuron excitability and firing patterns
claims.quote: but had altered cortical neuron excitability and firing patterns.

claims.object_text: Depdc5(+/-) rats display cortical cytomegalic dysmorphic neurons and balloon-like cells strongly expressing phosphorylated rpS6 (indicative of mTORC1 upregulation)
claims.quote: Depdc5(+/-) rats displayed cortical cytomegalic dysmorphic neurons and balloon-like cells strongly expressing phosphorylated rpS6, indicative of mTORC1 upregulation, and not observed after prenatal rapamycin treatment.
